posts.hook: Bone can change after teeth are gone.
posts.body: A denture does not replace the root, so the jaw under it can change and the fit can loosen. An implant sits in the bone. Whether you have enough bone is a scan question, not a guess. No percentage belongs in this post.
posts.grounding: Do not repeat the unsourced 50 percent grafting claim from the Gemini list.

posts.hook: Pain is the question. Here is the honest shape of it.
posts.body: Implant surgery is done with anesthesia, and sedation is available. Afterwards people have swelling and soreness that eases over days, not a script from an ad. Your surgeon gives the instructions. This post does not list doses.
posts.grounding: No dosing. Anxiety cluster. Do not promise a painless procedure.

posts.hook: How to clean a fixed bridge without folklore.
posts.body: Brush it. Clean under the bridge the way the hygienist shows you, often with floss threaders or a water flosser if they say it is appropriate. Skip the homemade recipes. The aftercare visit is where the routine is set.
posts.grounding: Aftercare education. No product ranking and no unsourced best-toothpaste claim.

posts.hook: What to eat in the first weeks is mostly soft.
posts.body: Soups, eggs, yogurt, and tender fish while the implants settle. The team writes the food list for your case. A steak is not the day-one story, whatever an ad once promised.
